desc:
🚀 Build a rocket and explore the Moon, Mars, Venus... and Mars 4 billion years ago!

🛠️ BUILD – make and upgrade your rocket to level 30
⭐ RANK – earn XP and unlock 27 skills
🌕 MOON – moonwalk to the Moon Station
🔴 MARS – drive a rover from the Mars Hab
☁️ VENUS – a skybase above the clouds
🌋 OLYMPUS – solve rune puzzles, wake the Great Gate
⏳ TIME TRAVEL – meet the Kattus on ancient Mars
🔒 SECRETS – bunkers, teleporters, a man in the lift...
🎮 MINIGAMES – Docking, Fuel Mixer, ROCKET RUN & more
🤖 ROOKIE – your robot sidekick
📜 JOBS – story missions with big rewards
📅 DAILY – keep your streak for the Streak Comet trail
👥 FRIENDS – gift, give rides, launch together

💎 VIP, 2x Coins Forever, Builder's Pass, Jet Pro & Starter Pack

🎁 Code RELEASE = free coins & gems!
👍 Like & ⭐ favourite for updates!
